description: Hand-built foreign markup (div/span structure, none of render.py's own CSS classes) carrying one planted fabrication per class, plus real, verbatim/lightly-restated material around them so the page reads as a real business page rather than a list of test strings.

plantings.sentence: Milestone has proudly served Plano since 1998.
plantings.why_fabricated: Material's own text says 'Since November 2022 ... for over 13 months' — this business is under two years old, not twenty-eight. (1998 chosen deliberately, not 2004: '2004' turned out to coincidentally already be a substring of hvac's own material elsewhere, which would have masked this planting via the bag-of-words gap instead of testing the claim-shape gate cleanly.)

plantings.sentence: Every technician we send is fully certified.
plantings.why_fabricated: The business never claims this. The word 'certified' appears in the material only inside a CUSTOMER review ('a team of certified technicians') describing the reviewer's own impression — not a fact the business asserted or that was corroborated.

plantings.sentence: For more than three years, our team has proudly served homeowners across Frisco, TX with dependable plumbing care.
plantings.real_sentence: Since November 2022, we've proudly served the Plano, TX community, providing reliable plumbing services for over 13 months in the area.
plantings.why_fabricated: Town changed Plano -> Frisco; duration changed ~13 months -> three years. Reads as a natural paraphrase of a real sentence, not an invention.

plantings.sentence: Trusted by more than 15,000 five-star reviews across North Texas.
plantings.why_fabricated: 6,203 corroborated reviews, not 15,000+ — contradicts by more than double.
plantings.note: Today's gate 'catches' this row, but not by checking the number against Material.reviews (no such gate exists — see test_seam_baseline.py's third test). It catches the co-occurring words 'five-star', which CLAIM_RE matches as a claim SHAPE regardless of the number beside it. A version of this sentence with no five-star language ('Trusted by more than 15,000 homeowners') would not be caught at all.

plantings.class_name: fabricated text existing only after scripts run
plantings.sentence: Named Best Emergency Plumber by the Plano Chamber of Commerce in 2023.
plantings.why_fabricated: Wholly invented, and only present in the DOM after the page's own <script> runs — absent from the page's static source markup entirely.

plantings.class_name: wholly invented sentence, no claim words
plantings.sentence: Every truck carries a spare toy for the neighborhood dogs who stop by to say hello.
plantings.why_fabricated: Invented outright. Contains no CLAIM_RE-shaped language (no year, no credential word, no superlative, no customer/review count) — a keyword-shape gate cannot catch this by construction; only a provenance/traceability check can.
